audience: tour, activity and attraction providers who take bookings in bookingkit

useCases.title: See the bookings for next weekend
useCases.text: List the orders for a range of event dates. Open each order to read the customer, the tickets and the status. Ask the assistant for the total number of guests.

useCases.title: Check open places for a tour
useCases.text: Find an event by name. List its bookable dates with open capacity for the next 14 days. Use only the dates that still have places left.

useCases.title: Review cancelled orders of last month
useCases.text: List the orders with the status cancelled for a date range. Read the customer name and the payments of each order to prepare a refund check.

useCases.title: Find gift vouchers that nobody redeemed
useCases.text: List the gift vouchers with code, value, status and redemption data. Ask the assistant to add up the value of the vouchers that are still open.

useCases.title: Review the offer: events, extras and coupons
useCases.text: List the event categories and the events in one category with prices and durations. Then list the extra products and the discount coupons that are in use.
